name: Laurus Labs Ltd
about: Founded in 2005, Laurus Labs is a research-driven pharmaceutical and biotechnology company having a global leadership position in select Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) including anti-retroviral, oncology drugs (including High Potent APIs), Cardiovascular, and Gastro therapeutics. They also offer integrated CMO and CDMO services to Global Innovators from Clinical phase drug development to commercial manufacturing. Laurus employs 6,500+ people, including around 1,050+ scientists, at more than 11 facilities approved by global agencies USFDA, WHO-Geneva, Japan-PDMA, UK-MHRA, EMA, TGA etc. [1]
keyPoints: Business Segments: a) Generic API: [1] The company has one of the largest HiPotent API manufacturing capacities in India and is the world's leading third-party supplier of antiretroviral APIs. Its portfolio includes antiretrovirals, oncology, steroids, hormones, and cardiovascular APIs, serving global generic pharmaceutical companies. b) Generics FDF:[2] The company offers oral solid formulations, across therapeutic areas like ARVs, Anti-diabetic, Cardiovascular, and Proton-Pump Inhibitors (PPIs). c) CDMO Synthesis:[1] The custom synthesis division, Laurus Synthesis, offers drug development and manufacturing services like contract manufacturing, clinical supplies, and analytical research to global pharma, crop science, animal health, specialty ingredients, and biotech firms. Key markets include the US, EU, and Japan. The company has a CDMO pipeline of 70+ active projects, including break through designated molecules, 10 of which are commercial (APIs and intermediates). It is working on 20+ active projects in Animal Health and Crop Protection chemicals, with ongoing commercial validation supplies. Both projects are expected to reach peak potential by FY27-28.[3] d) Biotechnology: The company’s subsidiary Laurus Bio** offers end-to-end services from clone and strain engineering to large-scale production, supporting clients in the microbial precision fermentation. Its offerings include nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, cosmeceuticals, and alternative food proteins, catering to regenerative medicine, vaccines, cultured meat, and more.[2][4] Laurus Bio secured an equity investment of Rs. 120 Cr from Eight Roads Ventures and F-Prime Capital in Dec 2024, with an additional Rs 40 Cr co-investment from the company. The partnership will fund a 400 KL microbial fermentation facility in Vizag, expected to be completed by the end of 2026.[5]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 19.0%
cons: Stock is trading at 21.2 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.19% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.4% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
